Application Data.NAME: Precision Tire & Automotive Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Tire & Automotive Center specializes in tire sales, automotive maintenance, and minor repair services. Our operations include tire inspections, rotations, balancing, oil changes, battery replacements, and the sale of new tires from reputable manufacturers. We prioritize safety and adhere to documented protocols to ensure compliance with OSHA regulations. Our facility is equipped with a well-trained staff and proper fire protection measures to mitigate operational risks. Delivery services for customer vehicles are available, enhancing convenience without engaging in towing or high-risk activities.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, an oil spill occurred during routine maintenance, resulting in a cleanup cost of $1,500. The claim was closed, and all safety protocols were followed. On 03/10/2023, a minor slip and fall incident was reported, leading to an expense of $3,500 for medical bills and preventive safety enhancements. The claim was settled, and no further action is pending.
